Andre Botha · Lead Product Designer

Olay.com design system and visual work

The Madonna Library is the design system I built for Olay.com, P&G's direct-to-consumer skincare store. These are pages from the library itself: the type, controls and cards the whole storefront is built from.

Healio walkthrough deck andrebotha.co

The library

Madonna Library, version 2.0

The component library behind Olay.com: one source for type, color, grids, icons, controls and every card the storefront uses.

Typography

One family carries the hierarchy

Franklin ITC Pro in Bold, Medium, Light and Light Italic. Size and weight do the work, with separate desktop and mobile scales for six headlines, labels, body copy and buttons.

Product cards

Built to sell in a glance

Large and small product cards with a NEW flag, regular and sale pricing, benefit tags like Extra Hydrating and Brightening, and an Add to Bag button.

Controls

Every button, every state

Primary, secondary and tertiary calls to action from default through disabled, plus radio buttons, variant selectors, dropdowns and product card buttons.

Disruptor cards

Breaking up the grid

Editorial tiles that sit inside the product grid, like "Find Products Made for You," in large and small sizes.

Ingredient cards

Education at the shelf

Ingredient cards that explain what each one is good for, with a See Details link, in two sizes.
